purpose: Independent native low-frequency chirp observations and conservative cross-window correspondence. This is not common engine phase, physical separation, a warm-idle/RPM label, or a new synthesis profile.
design: Native unpadded0.5s Hann peaks, no central inventory/rank identity or fixed anchor radius. Peak selector is new and is not a repair/promotion of old modal fit. Each frequency remains in its native half-bin and below45% of its nearest neighbour spacing; independent q has one declared +/-80Hz/s range. Reuse original line_motion local-chirp waveform/Jacobian, observed q=0 and weighted linear amplitude/DC initialization, original finite60-evaluation budget. Fit L, then linear R at identical f/q, without forcing shared amplitudes/phases. Model limitations and bound contacts are reported, not removed by wider ranges. Candidate overflow rejects rather than picking strongest32. No spectral warp, shared-clock fit, AM degree/threshold/seed/window sweep.
eligibility: Numerical success, no own f/q bound contact and >=80% removal of local Hann spectral power after all other fitted lines are subtracted. This is conditional model support, not a physical source detector or independent validation. Retain every candidate, fit and failure.
known_controls: Native stationary and chirping tones, moving3+fixed3 mixture, neighboring moving+fixed pair, gain invariance, actual absent-line case, silence, deterministic noise, symmetric crossing. Known originals are never passed as fit initialization. Positive gates fixed above; crossing/noise need no qualified line/correspondence. Synthetic controls precede real-source read. If any assertion fails preserve exact source and do not read recordings.
link_policy: Both forward f+q*hop and backward f-q*hop predictions must be within0.5Hz and q change<=8Hz/s. Only degree-one on both ends inherits identity; ties end tracks, no gap fill or reconnect. Five contiguous windows required for local moving/stationary classification; unresolved remains unresolved. Labels denote behavior of this local model, not mechanical parts.
source_policy: Read only the two unchanged training.wav files in fixed_source_profiles_v1/trial1, checking against its immutable freeze. No holdout read, source recrop, new media, exported WAV/profile, C/voice/default/UI/runtime/space change or repeat of59CTest. Original common-phase qualification remains required for a new shared-phase DNA. Existing F2V2 listening question stays pending, no duplicate. Use this result to decide the next actual source extraction, not as listening acceptance.
